descFull: The open-source time-series lakehouse. Keep every telemetry reading: hot data fast, cold history cheap in your own bucket, one SQL across both. Telegraf and Line Protocol in, Parquet out, published as Iceberg tables Snowflake, Databricks and Athena read in place. 38M+ records/sec. Single binary. Air-gap ready. AGPL-3.0.
